_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Engineering Services Memorandum (ESM)
summary: The Engineering Services Memorandum identifies the objectives, estimated cost, and timeframe of major milestones for engineering services work, with base ESMs identifying work areas and sub-ESMs addressing a specific portion of the base ESM.
description_purpose:
3.1 An ESM identifies the objectives to be obtained, the estimated cost, and the timeframe of major milestones of the effort.
3.2 Base ESMs are used to identify each area of work to be performed on engineering services contracts. Sub-ESMs address a specific portion of the base ESM.
application_interrelationship:
7.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement for this data included in the contract.
7.2 This DID may be applied in any engineering services-to-support production contract to acquire base ESMs and Sub-ESMs.
7.3 This DID supersedes DI-A-1039.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The ESM format shall be contractor selected. Unless effective presentation would be degraded, the initially used format arrangement shall be used for all subsequent submissions.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The ESM shall contain the following information:

children.title: ESM Number - Sub ESMs to be point number of Base ESM.
Need for proposed work and objectives.
Estimated cost of engineering, materials, and equipment or services.
Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) item, date required, return date, condition on return.
Submitted by - Signature and title of company official.
